title: Dreamy current-run acceptance manifest
description: Declares one run-scoped evidence directory and the artifacts it covers. The citation gate reads exactly one such run, named by an explicitly supplied manifest path. There is deliberately no directory-scan fallback and no 'latest run' auto-discovery: an empty or wrong directory yields zero anchors, zero failures, and a false PASS, so the run must be named and its contents hash-verified. Historical evidence outside the declared run is never swept.

schema_version.description: Manifest contract version. A validator MUST reject a version it does not know rather than guessing at the shape.

run_id.description: Unique run identifier. Must match the run directory's basename so a manifest cannot silently describe a different directory.

gate.description: Which gate from docs/acceptance/GATE-MATRIX.md this run claims to supply evidence for. A run whose gate is BLOCKED in the matrix MUST be rejected: a gate cannot be satisfied while its own prerequisites are recorded as unmet.

requirement_ids.description: Requirement IDs from docs/specifications/SPEC-DREAMY-V2.md that this run supplies evidence for. Every ID MUST be defined normatively in the specification.

commit.description: Full git SHA the evidence was produced against.

generated_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of manifest generation.

root.description: Absolute path to the run directory. Absolute by necessity - a manifest is not committed, and the gate must resolve it on this machine. The validator MUST resolve symlinks and confirm containment under the acceptance-runs base, so a link cannot smuggle in a tree outside it. Committed documents use placeholders instead; this file is generated, never version-controlled.

artifacts.description: Artifacts this run declares, keyed by artifact kind. Keyed rather than a list so a run cannot satisfy its contract by supplying the same document twice under different names.

path.description: Path relative to root. MUST NOT be absolute and MUST NOT escape the run directory, so a manifest stays relocatable and cannot point at arbitrary filesystem locations.

sha256.description: Hex sha256 of the file's bytes. Verified at gate time; a mismatch is a hard failure, never a warning.

lines.description: Optional line count, so a citation naming a line range can be bounds-checked without opening the file.

independent_review.description: The reviewer verdict covering this run. A hash-verified manifest is necessary but NOT sufficient: a manifest honestly declaring one harmless file passes every integrity check and proves nothing. A run whose review reports blocking findings MUST NOT yield a green gate.

verdict.description: PASS admits the run. PASS_WITH_MINOR admits it with non-blocking findings recorded. Every other value blocks.

artifact.description: Artifact key, present in `artifacts`, holding the reviewer's machine-readable verdict.

reviewer.description: Identifier of the reviewing agent or person. MUST differ from `producer`. Enforced as a declared-name inequality only: both fields are self-asserted, so this cannot prove the review was genuinely independent.

producer.description: Identifier of the agent or person that PRODUCED the artifacts. Recorded so the reviewer-differs-from-producer check has something to compare against. Self-asserted; not cryptographically bound to the actual producer.
